orig: A self-paced path for the Veeam Data Platform administrator who has been handed Veeam Kasten and a Kubernetes cluster to protect. Veeam Kasten for Kubernetes is an application-centric platform for Kubernetes backup, disaster recovery, and application mobility — this course maps it onto the backup knowledge you already have, then takes you through deployment, ongoing maintenance, restores, and the daily admin routine.

why: Naming standard: full name on first use, short form after. The lede does it backwards inside a single paragraph — short form in sentence one, full form in sentence two — which reads as though two products are being introduced. Swapping the two occurrences costs nothing and puts the canonical form where a first-time reader meets the product. glossary.md, Veeam Kasten for Kubernetes entry (First-use / Subsequent).
